title: Piloting a four-day week for one quarter
variant: Serif body with a sticky sidebar of facts and the recommendation
prompt: Brief me on piloting a four-day work week for our 25-person team for one quarter.
note: Two columns at laptop width: the memo body on the left in a generous serif at a comfortable measure, and a sticky sidebar on the right holding the key facts and a brand recommendation card, so the numbers and the answer stay in view while the reader works through the argument. The options are a run of short headed sections with one compact Cost, Risk, and Forecloses row each rather than cards, because the reasoning about each option matters more here than a line-for-line comparison.
